# text-checks' fetch (.github/workflows/ci-job-text-checks.yaml): the modules of each module's text
# checks, of the Dispatch API's source guards and of the supervise table's pins, which its go test
# steps run; the Dispatch server the copy-lock guard lists with -export
# (internal/dispatch/api/copy_lock_order_test.go); the infra packages the infra text checks
# list (internal/textcheck/core_imports_test.go); and what `go mod tidy` reads in each module a
# required job builds, which the tidy check (.github/scripts/check-go-tidy.sh) reads with the proxy
# off: more than any build of those modules loads, one `tidy` line a module.
deps packages/envoy -test ./internal/textcheck/ ./internal/dispatch/api/
deps packages/envoy ./cmd/dispatch
deps packages/envoy/infra -test ./internal/textcheck/
deps packages/envoy/infra ./core ./gcp
deps packages/daemon -test ./internal/textcheck/ ./internal/supervise/
tidy packages/daemon
tidy packages/envoy
tidy packages/envoy/infra
